nonNegotiableRules: KYC must be VERIFIED before commercial identity or membership activation.
KYB must be VERIFIED before B2B or B2G commercial access.
Product, service, and asset verification are independent from KYB.
Matching must evaluate relationship, geography, capacity, certification, SLA, and eligibility.
Sensitive actions require server-side RBAC + ABAC checks and WORM audit records.
Public, verified, restricted, and confidential data must not be mixed in one visibility scope.
